readings.moment: The temple struck nine, when the master had everyone show their watches at dinner.
The hall clock downstairs struck ten.
The regulator showed twelve minutes to ten when the hall clock struck ten.
The regulator agreed with the temple bell exactly when the temple struck ten.
The regulator showed twenty past ten when the master sent Lina downstairs.
When Madame's piano began, Rosa's clock showed two minutes to eleven.
When the piano stopped, Rosa's clock showed eleven minutes past eleven.
The temple struck eleven, after which Lina stayed in the kitchen until just after.

durations: four years ago (Lina came up from Le Locle to learn the hairsprings)
Four years (the master's work on the repeater)
whereabouts: After dinner, Lina went up to the atelier to work beside the master.
After dinner, the master was in the atelier with Lina.
The master sent Lina downstairs from the atelier when the regulator showed twenty past ten.
Lina went straight down to the kitchen after leaving the atelier.
When Madame began to play, Lina was in the kitchen with Rosa.
Lina stayed in the kitchen with Rosa until after the temple struck eleven.
